description: Work out what level a role really needs (by scope, not years), or what level a candidate really is from a CV, interview notes or an assessment report. Flags title inflation and gives 3 questions that separate adjacent levels.

candidate_evidence.description: CV text, interview notes, an interview scorecard or an assessment report (remove contact details, IDs and dates of birth)

company_size.description: Your company size and stage, e.g. "8 people, seed"

mode.description: "role" = what level do I need; "candidate" = what level is this person

role_description.description: The work: what they will own, who reviews them, how vague the goals are (or paste a role scorecard)

name: calibrate_seniority
title: Calibrate Seniority
